_comment: movement-first combat input: arrows step the active unit directly during the player's turn (spending move pool, refused steps spend nothing). Dash (slot 2) requires an Enter confirm before it fires. Ends mid-combat on purpose. the PC is CLASSLESS at boot now, but this script needs the WARRIOR kit fielded (slot 3 = [Power Strike], the _bb_escape regression tooth) AND a deterministic in-arena trajectory (the manual cell asserts assume the pc's opening corner stays clear as relc's AI moves off its spawn). Both are met by starting from the shared post_tutorial FIXTURE (warrior L1, rusty_sword equipped -> power_strike fielded, met_relc -> relc allied, floodplains 7,6) via the title 'Continue' load: the fixture sets rng.state directly (int of its rng_state), so goblin_encounter_2 -- the FIRST combat after load, drawing rng.randi() straight from that state with no pre-fight combat consuming rng -- is deterministic per the fixture, not per --seed. This script is post_tutorial's outcome-defining consumer; its rng_state is tuned so relc vacates the pc's west corner. Ends mid-fight, so no victory assert.

Regression tooth: _bb_escape must NOT self-collide -- selecting the [Power Strike] slot (index 2, key 3; AP 3 == exactly the 3 AP left post-dash) must emit its slot-info line with the CORRECT '[lb]Power Strike[rb]' escape. post_tutorial equips the rusty_sword so power_strike (weapon:sword) fields at slot 2. The cost/effect segment is GENERATED by WIEffectText.skill_effect_lines (power_strike's damage_mult 2.0 -> '×2 damage') instead of the pre-L3 hand-composed bare AP cost -- the exact gap this milestone kills (the ×2 damage multiplier was previously invisible on this line). GH#337 adds the generated cooldown clause to the same segment -- a cooldown is a combat resource of AP's own class (spec ruling 5), so the line states the every-other-round restriction before the player spends a turn discovering it. The description is GONE from the pin on purpose: this strip is fitted to a fixed pixel budget and the clause is what pushed it over, so `_slot_info_line` drops the flavour rather than let the fitter ellipsise the mechanical statement. This assertion is now the string the PLAYER sees -- compare 03_power_strike_slot_info.png, which must render it whole with no trailing ellipsis.
